request: 2011-W45 相比 2011-W44，GMV 变化了多少？给出两周的 GMV、差额（W45 减 W44）和变化率。
sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT week,
         sum(gmv_amount) AS gmv,
         count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
         count(DISTINCT order_date) FILTER (WHERE line_type = '销售') AS trading_days,
         count(*) AS line_rows
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE week IN ('2011-W44', '2011-W45')
  GROUP BY week
)
SELECT
  round(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44'), 2) AS gmv_2011_w44,
  round(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W45'), 2) AS gmv_2011_w45,
  round(sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W45') - sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44'), 2) AS gmv_change,
  round((sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W45') - sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44'))
        / sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44'), 4) AS gmv_change_rate,
  sum(orders) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44') AS orders_2011_w44,
  sum(orders) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W45') AS orders_2011_w45,
  sum(trading_days) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44') AS trading_days_2011_w44,
  sum(trading_days) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W45') AS trading_days_2011_w45,
  sum(line_rows) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W44') AS line_rows_2011_w44,
  sum(line_rows) FILTER (WHERE week = '2011-W45') AS line_rows_2011_w45
FROM weekly

columns.name: gmv_2011_w44
columns.meaning: 2011-W44 的 GMV（英镑，下单口径 sum(gmv_amount)）

columns.name: gmv_2011_w45
columns.meaning: 2011-W45 的 GMV（英镑，下单口径 sum(gmv_amount)）

columns.name: gmv_change
columns.meaning: GMV 差额 = W45 − W44（英镑）

columns.name: orders_2011_w44
columns.meaning: 2011-W44 销售订单数（count(distinct order_id)，只数销售订单）

columns.name: orders_2011_w45
columns.meaning: 2011-W45 销售订单数（count(distinct order_id)，只数销售订单）

definition: 口径：GMV = sum(gmv_amount)，按表的 ISO 周字段 week 分组统计（2011-W44 对应 2011-10-31~2011-11-06，2011-W45 对应 2011-11-07~2011-11-13）；差额 = W45 GMV − W44 GMV；变化率 = 差额 / W44 GMV，保留 4 位小数。订单数 = count(distinct order_id)（只数销售订单），交易天数 = count(distinct order_date) filter (where line_type='销售')。
caveats: GMV 为下单口径，包含随后被取消的订单；W45 取消金额（7,583.32 英镑）高于 W44（4,403.33 英镑），净销售额增幅会小于 GMV 增幅。
两周都是有 6 个销售日的完整周（周日无交易），周与周可比；2011-W49 不完整的问题与本次对比无关。
少数大额且很快全额取消的订单会抬高当周 GMV，两周均可能有此影响。
GMV 含缺客户 ID 的游客订单金额。
